examples.title: UI kit gallery
examples.summary: Every irender-ui-kit component in its variants: buttons, badges, cards, alerts, form controls, table, pagination and more. Follows your system's dark mode.

examples.title: Orders dashboard
examples.summary: KPI tiles, filter tabs and expandable order rows, built from server data and a folder of fragments.

examples.title: Live search
examples.summary: Fetches results when the page opens and on every search, then rebuilds the result cards from each response.

examples.title: Sign-up wizard
examples.summary: Four steps with conditional fields, validation, a select, a textarea and a review screen. No server at all.

examples.title: Storefront
examples.summary: A layout whose nav, campaign banner and recommendations are generated in Rust. The cart is handled by host JavaScript.

examples.title: Storefront, variant B
examples.summary: The same page with the other A/B arm: a compact banner with the button beside the text.

examples.title: Product card
examples.summary: Quantity stepper, live price and progress bar, and a buy button that hands off to the host.

examples.title: Counter
examples.summary: The smallest interactive document: two buttons and a number that turns red below zero.
